# The Practical AI Co.

> The Practical AI Co. builds done-for-you AI automation for small businesses — social content pipelines, product listing engines, and back-office follow-up systems — delivered working at fixed prices, with human approval on everything the automation sends or publishes. Based in Australia. We also publish free plain-English guides and a weekly newsletter teaching practical AI to non-technical professionals.

The Practical AI Co. is an Australian automation studio for small businesses: cafés, trades, boutiques, online sellers, solo operators and small teams. Every system we sell is one we first built and ran on our own businesses. No sales calls — projects start with one email, or a conversation with Frank on the site, describing the task the owner wants automated, and we reply with a fixed-price scope.

## Services

- [Content Autopilot](https://practicalaico.ai/#build): From A$990 setup + A$390/month. 8–12 branded social posts a week — researched, written, designed and scheduled to Facebook, Instagram, TikTok or LinkedIn. The owner approves each week's content with one tap; nothing posts without approval.
- [Product Listing Engine](https://practicalaico.ai/#build): From A$690 per catalogue run. For Etsy, Shopify and print-on-demand sellers — turns a product list into finished listings (titles, tags, descriptions, mockup images) with an automated quality gate that reads every image and holds anything with a typo or print error. Printify integrated.
- [Back-Office Autopilot](https://practicalaico.ai/#build): From A$1,490 setup + A$490/month. Quote and invoice follow-ups, review responses and appointment reminders drafted automatically and queued for one-tap owner approval, plus a daily briefing of what needs attention.
- Custom builds: scoped at a fixed price from a plain-English description of the task.

## FRANK

[FRANK](https://practicalaico.ai/#frank) is our flagship: an operations core that runs on the owner's own machine and does the running-a-company work — drafts emails, builds a daily briefing, tracks spend against budget, watches the jobs meant to run overnight and reports the ones that failed. 44 working skills with 523 automated tests behind them. Anything involving money or the outside world stops at an approval gate and waits for a human.

FRANK is not for sale yet. Early access is open at https://practicalaico.ai/#frank — the first group gets the demo before general release.

Frank also appears on this site as a chat and voice concierge that answers visitor questions, scopes projects and takes down lead details for a person to follow up — he always discloses he's AI and never books or promises anything without a human confirming it first.

## The Approval Gate

Every system we ship holds anything that sends, spends or publishes in a queue until a person releases it. This is not configurable. It is the reason our automations can be trusted with a business's public reputation and its money, and it is what separates us from AI agencies that let a model post unattended.

## How It Works

1. Email the task you want automated (plain English, screenshots welcome) to hello@practicalaico.ai, or describe it to Frank in the chat/voice widget on the site
2. We build the automation and demo it running on your real work before you pay the balance
3. The system runs on schedule with one-tap approvals; first month of monitoring and tuning included
